rec.name: Collection Grid Quick Add to Cart (with Mobile Bottom Size Picker)
rec.status: Built — merged into live theme (disabled by default, client decides when to enable)

what.text: A small cart/bag icon in the bottom-right corner of each product card image in the collection grid. Tapping it lets shoppers add a product straight from the grid without opening the PDP. On mobile, the variant (size) selector slides up as a bar at the bottom of the screen with size buttons (XS, S, M, L, XL, XXL) and a close (X) button. Sold-out sizes show an envelope icon (apparently a back-in-stock notification). It is available as a theme setting called 'Quick Add to Cart (custom)' under 'Products grid'.

why.text: It removes steps between browsing and adding to cart (collection → PDP → select size → add). Less friction means more add-to-carts, especially on mobile, where page loads are costly. A bottom-anchored picker sits in the thumb zone and keeps the shopper in the browsing context. Showing every size, including sold-out ones with a notify option, sets clear availability expectations and captures demand.

how.text: Add a quick-add button, absolutely positioned bottom-right on the product card media, and render it conditionally from a theme setting under 'Products grid' (disabled by default). On click, show variant options. On desktop, the selector appears within or on the card. On mobile, it appears as a fixed bottom sheet or bar. Selecting a size posts to /cart/add.js and updates the cart count and drawer. Render ALL variants, not only the first few, because the client reported that sizes above L were missing even though XL and XXL were in stock. Mark unavailable variants distinctly, with a notify icon. Inherit the theme font-family instead of hardcoding it. Size the icon separately for mobile and desktop: on mobile it was too large and overlapped the product images, and on desktop it was slightly too small. Make sure it stays visible on dark product images (the black hoodie).

items: Enable/disable Quick Add to Cart (custom) under Theme settings → Products grid (off by default)
Icon size (separate for mobile and desktop) and placement over the product image
Mobile: bottom-sheet size selector instead of an in-card popup
Close (X) button on the selector bar

dependencies.text: Shopify theme with a product grid section and a 'Products grid' theme settings group. Product variants (size) with availability data. Cart AJAX API (/cart/add.js) and a cart count update. The sold-out envelope icon suggests a back-in-stock or notify-me feature or app, but this is not confirmed. A separate 'CP product slider' feature exists in the dev theme but is not part of this element.

items: Collection → PDP click-through rate (expected to drop)
Mobile conversion rate and revenue per session
Back-in-stock notify sign-ups (if the envelope is functional)
